message.content:
This editorial illustration depicts a magazine cover for "TEMPO" dated "1-7 FEBRUARI 2021". The masthead "TEMPO" is centered at the top in large, grey, serif capital letters, with "50 Tahun!" written in cursive below it. To the left, a thick red vertical stripe runs down the edge.

The central figure is an anthropomorphic rat from the chest up, facing forward. The rat has dark grey fur, pinkish ears, and red eyes. It is dressed in academic regalia, including a grey robe and a red stole adorned with large, circular, white gear-like medallions. Around its neck is a white pleated ruff. On its head sits a black square academic cap (mortarboard). Hanging from the orange tassel of the cap is a white rectangular tag with a barcode and the numbers "1 234567 890128".

The background is plain white. To the left of the rat, bold black text reads "WAJAH KUSAM KAMPUS". Below this, smaller black text provides further detail: "Sejumlah rektor perguruan tinggi yang diduga menjiplak karya ilmiah lolos dari sanksi. Universitas sibuk mengejar peringkat, mengabaikan mutu riset." Other headlines at the top include "TARIK-ULUR ATURAN ENERGI TERBARUKAN" and "MELACAK MISTERI RELIEF SARINAH". The bottom left features price, date, and a barcode.
